declaration_policy: Where older matching reconstructions rely on live incoming GPRs or retain decompiler-only extra arguments, the canonical source declaration intentionally keeps an unspecified parameter list while fixing the return register class. Tightening those parameter lists changes proven retail-matching code generation. Explicit pointer/integer casts were added only where unifying the correct return class required them; objdiff and the linked DOL verify that they are byte-neutral.
